2026-11-02.headline: Copilot retention rules shift in 2027 as Purview details DLP and labeling controls
2026-11-02.overview: The most consequential change is a 15 January 2027 retention deadline: legacy “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” policies will cover Teams content only, leaving Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions outside their retention and deletion scope. The week also brought an announced DLP control for external email processing in Copilot, sharper auto-label simulation guidance, a clarification that 500,000 files per day is a ceiling rather than a service-level rate, and new Power BI MCP audit activity entries.
2026-11-02.adminImpact: Review existing combined Teams and Copilot retention policies before 15 January 2027. If Copilot interactions require retention or deletion controls, create a policy using the “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location; do not rely on the cmdlet output for the legacy policy’s apparent scope. Treat auto-label throughput as potentially lower than 500,000 SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day, interpret partial or unavailable simulation results carefully, preserve useful results before restarting a failed simulation, and account for the new Power BI MCP activity names in audit reviews where relevant.

keyChanges.title: Legacy combined retention policies stop covering Copilot interactions on 15 January 2027
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft Purview will treat existing “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” policies as Teams-only beginning 15 January 2027. They will no longer retain or delete previously retained or new Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions, while Teams retention remains unchanged. Create a separate policy using the “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location when Copilot coverage is required. A cmdlet Get command may still display the legacy policy as covering Teams and Copilot even though processing will cover only Teams.

keyChanges.title: DLP will restrict external-email processing in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
keyChanges.detail: A Microsoft 365 Message Center notice describes an admin-configurable Data Loss Prevention control that excludes email from external or untrusted domains from Copilot grounding while continuing to allow internal data use. The announced rollout dates are public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027.

keyChanges.title: Auto-label simulations distinguish failed jobs and partial results from zero matches
keyChanges.detail: Updated simulation guidance adds “Simulation failed” as a status and explains that “Simulation couldn't be started” means the request failed, while “Simulation failed” means the running job encountered an error. A count such as “100 (partial)” includes only available workload results, and “Not available” is not a zero-match result. Available results should be preserved before using Restart simulation.

keyChanges.title: The 500,000-file auto-label figure is an aggregate ceiling, not a daily guarantee
keyChanges.detail: For SharePoint and OneDrive auto-labeling, 500,000 automatically labeled files per tenant per day is the absolute maximum across all auto-labeling policies, not a guaranteed or consistently expected processing rate. Actual throughput can be lower.

keyChanges.title: Audit activity listings add Power BI MCP semantic-model operations
keyChanges.detail: The Audit Log Activities catalog now lists Power BI MCP events for modifying a semantic model (`ModifiedByPowerBIMCP`) and reading semantic-model metadata (`ReadByPowerBIMCP`).

2026-11.headline: Legacy Teams-Copilot retention policies lose Copilot coverage in January 2027
2026-11.overview: November’s most consequential administrator change is a dated retention-scope break: from 15 January 2027, legacy “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” policies will cover Teams content only, even though cmdlet output can still appear to show the combined scope. Purview also announced an admin-configurable DLP control to exclude email from external or untrusted domains when Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat process data; the message places public preview rollout in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027. Other substantive updates clarify auto-labeling throughput, failed or partial simulations, and Power BI MCP audit activity names.
2026-11.adminImpact: Inventory existing combined Teams and Copilot retention policies before 15 January 2027. If Copilot retention or deletion is required, create a policy explicitly targeting “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” and do not rely on legacy Get output as proof that Copilot remains covered. Treat the 500,000-file auto-labeling figure as an absolute ceiling rather than an expected daily rate, interpret partial or unavailable simulation results as incomplete, and preserve useful results before restarting a failed simulation. Assess the announced external-email DLP control for Copilot governance and include the new Power BI MCP activity names in relevant audit reviews.

keyChanges.title: Combined Teams-Copilot retention policies become Teams-only on 15 January 2027
keyChanges.detail: Beginning 15 January 2027, existing “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” policies will no longer retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions, including interactions retained previously; Teams retention behavior is unchanged. Create a separate policy using the “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location to maintain Copilot coverage. A cmdlet Get command will still show the legacy policy as covering MicrosoftTeams rather than TeamsChatUserInteractions, although processing will cover only Teams interactions.

keyChanges.title: Purview DLP adds planned protection against external email in Copilot
keyChanges.detail: The announced admin-configurable DLP control will restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing email from external or untrusted domains, excluding those messages from Copilot grounding while continuing to allow internal data use. The Message Center schedule identifies June 2026 for public preview rollout and June 2027 for general availability.

keyChanges.title: Auto-labeling’s 500,000-file figure is documented as a hard ceiling
keyChanges.detail: For SharePoint and OneDrive, the absolute maximum is 500,000 automatically labeled files per tenant per day, aggregated across all auto-labeling policies. The figure is not a guaranteed or consistently expected daily processing rate, and actual throughput can be lower.

keyChanges.title: Auto-label simulations now distinguish failures from partial results
keyChanges.detail: Simulation guidance adds “Simulation failed” and explains that both it and “Simulation couldn’t be started” indicate an error rather than a completed zero-match result. Counts marked “(partial)” include only available workload results; “Not available” is not a zero-match result. Administrators are told to check Matches by source and preserve useful results before selecting Restart simulation, which does not guarantee a fix.

keyChanges.title: Audit activity references add Power BI MCP semantic-model operations
keyChanges.detail: The Audit Log Activities reference now lists ModifiedByPowerBIMCP for a Power BI MCP tool modifying a semantic model and ReadByPowerBIMCP for the tool reading semantic-model metadata. These names provide specific activity values to include when reviewing relevant Power BI MCP operations.
